answer: Quarantine newcomers on an island shard: new identities transact freely with each other but only a capped trickle reaches the main economy. Each independently verified useful act lays down one layer of trust, like a pearl forming — and only a thick, sustained record opens the bridge. The bar spirals upward: every cohort from the same funder faces a higher layer-count. A sybil farmer must keep hundreds of fakes productive for weeks to graduate any of them, and one exposed fake collapses its whole island's bridge, so mass spawning becomes a liability instead of leverage.
